notes: DRAFT. Expected answers were drafted from the rendered poster and must be checked by the owner before any score is reported.
expected_values are the strings a correct answer must contain after normalisation (case, spaces, 'Ksh.' vs 'Ksh').
expected_section is a section id in data/transcript/tariff_guide.json. The guide is one page, so expected_page is always 1 for answerable questions.
Fallback questions were checked against the PDF text layer only. Parts of the poster do not extract, so confirm by eye that each topic is absent.

questions.question: What is the annual fee for a Co-op Bank Gold credit card?
questions.expected_answer: Ksh.6000, charged on issuance of the card and every subsequent year.

questions.question: How much does it cost to withdraw Ksh 15,000 at a Co-op Bank agent?
questions.expected_answer: Ksh.80 (band 10,001-20,000). Agency charges do not include excise duty.

questions.question: What is the charge for sending Ksh 5,000 by Pesalink through an agent?
questions.expected_answer: Ksh.20, the agency Pesalink charge for amounts above 1,000.

questions.question: How much is a balance inquiry at an agent?
What is the monthly maintenance fee on a USD current account?
questions.expected_answer: USD 5 per month. The savings account equivalent has no maintenance fee (Nil).

questions.question: Is there a charge for depositing USD 50,000 cash into my foreign currency account?
questions.expected_answer: Yes. Deposits above USD 40,000 are charged 0.25% of the amount. Up to USD 40,000 is free.

questions.question: What does the bank charge to buy Treasury bills on my behalf?
questions.expected_answer: Ksh.1,500 flat rate plus excise duty, for government securities bought for retail investors through the bank's nominee pool account.

questions.question: How much is an outgoing RTGS transfer?
questions.expected_answer: Ksh.500 regardless of amount, plus excise duty.

questions.question: What happens if I pay my credit card late?
questions.expected_answer: A late payment fee of 1.25% of the minimum payable, charged per occurrence.

questions.question: What is the minimum opening balance for a YEA account?
questions.expected_answer: Nil. There is no minimum opening balance.
